BiblicalUsage: A crown is the mark of honour, and this word follows it through the whole Bible. David took the crown of the Ammonite king, wisdom gives a crown of glory to the one who holds her, Isaiah says Zion will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and the king in the psalm received a crown of pure gold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the crown that matters is the one God sets on, not the one men take off. David could lift a crown from a conquered king, but only the LORD can make His people a crown of glory, and I hold that the honour He gives is the only one that lasts.
